description: This file contains auxiliary utility functions for the 'docmaker' tool, including functions for sorting, output redirection, file existence checks, and file list creation, used within the FreeType project's documentation generation process.

methods.name: index_key
methods.description: Generates a sorting key for strings that sorts lexicographically with uppercase letters before lowercase ones.

methods.name: sort_order_list
methods.description: Sorts a list, placing elements of 'order_list' at the front, followed by remaining elements.

methods.name: open_output
methods.description: Redirects standard output to a specified file, returning the file handle and original stdout.

methods.name: close_output
methods.description: Closes the output file and restores original stdout.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: make_file_list
methods.description: Builds a list of input files from command-line arguments, filtering out non-existent files.
